cards.nontext_preparation: Numeric finite float32; fitting-scope median, all-missing fallback0; categorical fitting-scope normalized frequencies, unknown0.

parameters_used_by_adapter.class_weight_power: existing worker fitting-label weights for classification

cards.stopping: No native or nested early stopping; all bounded requested trees fit.
limitations: Frequency encoding loses category identity; improvement is unmeasured.
Teacher selector, history, calibration and broad features are excluded from fixed METH01 method recipe.
Common worker memory/deadline still govern; 128 trees is not a memory guarantee.

METH01_registered_fixed_recipe.weight_scope: Inherited all3 strong-control components, not tuned

cards.no_text_preparation: Numeric SimpleImputer(median,keep_empty_features=True)+StandardScaler(with_mean=False); categorical sparse OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown=ignore,min_frequency=3); processor/estimator fit on worker fitting rows.
cards.regression_estimator: Ridge(alpha=10,solver=lsqr); text_alpha does not change Ridge alpha.
cards.class_order: Use worker/model classes and existing publishing probability_matrix alignment; test unknown categories and binary string labels before any fit pilot.
limitations: No native/nested early stopping in this branch.
Sparse OHE does not guarantee bounded width/peak memory on high-cardinality data; retain hard worker guard and measure.
Do not advertise history/target encoding/selector/data augmentation for this branch.
AUC/MacroF1/RMSE objectives and ranking remain the existing task objective; no threshold or class metric is substituted.
